system.description: This massive two-handed hammer is etched with elegant patterns that indicate its value. When held, it pulses with a power felt by all nearby, emitting an aura of menace that draws the attention foes.

extraordinaryProperties.name: special
extraordinaryProperties.value: The maul's aura boon can only emit the provoked bane. During the first round of combat, its aura can be invoked as a minor action.
